title: paeonia peregrina var. leiocarpa
intro: Paeonia peregrina var. leiocarpa, commonly known as Chinese peony or white peony, is a species of flowering plant in the peony family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia peregrina var. leiocarpa include sedative and anti-spasmodic effects, which may contribute to its use in treating conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
